summary_en: Interim dividend per share increased to ¥29.00 from ¥26.00 forecast. Full-year FY2027 dividend forecast raised to ¥58.00 per share from ¥52.00, reflecting upward revision of consolidated earnings guidance driven by strong North American subsidiary performance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Dividends (Interim Dividend with Increase) and Revision of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Maruichi Steel Tube announced on November 9, 2026, an increase in its interim dividend to ¥29.00 per share from the previously forecasted ¥26.00 per share, with an effect date of November 30, 2026. The total interim dividend amount is ¥6.394 billion. Concurrently, the company revised upward its full-year dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, raising the annual dividend per share to ¥58.00 from ¥52.00, an increase of ¥6.00 per share or 11.5%.

The revision reflects an upward adjustment of consolidated earnings guidance, driven by strong performance from the North American subsidiary. The company operates under a basic policy of determining dividends comprehensively based on parent company shareholders' attributable net profit at the consolidated level. For the final year of the 7th medium-term management plan, the company targets a consolidated payout ratio of 45%.

Note: The company implemented a 1-for-3 stock split effective October 1, 2025. The FY2026 interim dividend comparison figure of ¥22.33 per share reflects the impact of this split.
